title: GPT-4.1 Nano joins the anonymous tier
summary:
This week made the front door easier to use: GPT-4.1 Nano joined the anonymous tier, text generation became easier to measure without logging message content, and community projects gave people new places to talk to AI.

`openai-fast` (GPT-4.1 Nano) moved into the anonymous tier. The model listing also became easier to browse, with non-community models first and names sorted within each group.

Optional, content-free tracking now records timing, token usage, model, provider and outcome, while keeping tracking failures separate from generation. Cached-token counts are retained, and request handling and pricing lookups got tighter.

Two Roblox escape games joined the showcase, both making conversations with AI characters part of the puzzle. A celebrity-image tool was added too, while duplicate and outdated project listings were cleaned up.
